description: Source code for the 'clar' testing framework, including core test functions, error handling, sandboxing, and command-line argument parsing.

classes.name: clar_error
classes.description: Represents an error encountered during a test, including file, function, line, message, and description.

classes.name: clar_explicit
classes.description: Represents explicit test suite inclusion/exclusion filters.

classes.name: clar_report
classes.description: Contains information about individual test execution reports, including status and errors.

classes.name: clar_summary
classes.description: Holds summary report filename and file pointer.

classes.name: clar_func
classes.description: Represents a test function with name and pointer.

classes.name: clar_suite
classes.description: Defines a test suite with name, setup/teardown functions, list of tests, and enabled flag.

methods.name: clar_run_test
methods.description: Executes a single test, including setup, test execution, teardown, and error handling.

methods.name: clar_run_suite
methods.description: Runs all tests within a specified suite, applying filters and handling test execution flow.

methods.name: clar_parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to configure test execution.

methods.name: clar_test
methods.description: Main entry point to initialize, run, and shutdown tests, returning error count.
